title: India Cracks Hypersonic Code with DRDO Scramjet Test
excerpt: A successful scramjet engine demonstration puts India in an elite club of nations mastering hypersonic propulsion technology
body:
India's Defence Research and Development Organisation successfully demonstrated a domestically developed scramjet engine, marking a decisive step toward operational hypersonic missile capability. The test confirms India can now sustain supersonic combustion — the core engineering challenge of hypersonic flight — at speeds exceeding Mach 5.

**What DRDO achieved:**
A scramjet engine breathes atmospheric oxygen rather than carrying its own oxidiser, making it far lighter and faster than conventional rocket-propelled systems. Sustaining controlled combustion at hypersonic velocities is extraordinarily difficult — the air-fuel mixing window lasts mere milliseconds. DRDO's success places India alongside the United States, China, and Russia as nations with demonstrated scramjet capability.

**Why this matters for India's security posture:**
Hypersonic missiles are nearly impossible to intercept with existing air-defence systems because of their speed, altitude flexibility, and unpredictable flight paths. India's advancement comes at a time of sustained military modernisation driven by tensions on both its northern and western borders. A domestically sourced hypersonic strike capability reduces India's dependence on foreign defence suppliers — a long-standing strategic vulnerability.

**What to watch:**
The next milestone is an integrated flight test of a full hypersonic cruise missile system, likely within the next two to three years, which would validate end-to-end operational readiness.
